windows.60: Recent visitor reviews indicate concerns primarily about the food offerings at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Several guests found the menu limited and the quality of food lacking, with specific complaints about items being bland, poorly prepared, or not matching descriptions. Service and wait times were also mentioned but less frequently. While the overall rating remains above four, addressing the food quality and menu variety could improve visitor satisfaction.
windows.90: Visitor reviews over the last 90 days indicate significant dissatisfaction with the food service at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Many found the menu limited and the food quality poor, with several comments about overpriced items and small portions. Service issues were also noted, including long wait times and periods when kitchen orders were not being taken. While the library itself received some positive remarks, the café’s pricing, menu choices, and operational logistics need attention to improve visitor experience.
